deathBeat: d15: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Klaus Mikhailov is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d15: 🕯️ Klaus Mikhailov is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d15: The village's quarrel was with Klaus — and Klaus is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
recoverHome: d16: That night, they bring Klaus home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.
systemVoice: d15: SYSTEM: "Perimeter violated! This is unprecedented! ...Is this unprecedented? Checking. Yes. Unprecedented."
d15: SYSTEM: "INTRUDER REPELLED. The pantry’s aroma is now classified as a defensive liability. The audience is chanting the defenders’ names. Fan clubs are forming. This is how it starts."

d15: ◈ ARC III — ENGINES. SYSTEM: "VIEWERSHIP MILESTONE. Organic unit demonstrates compounding capability. Resonance protocols unlocked." — Your gifts deepen. Used in sequence, they resonate. The village is no longer just surviving. It is becoming something.
d17: ◈ SYSTEM: "PALISADE: ONLINE. Pointy! The audience approves of pointy. Raiders will think twice — the ones that can think. Sleep easy, little ones. The walls are watching so you do not have to."

d17: ◈ SYSTEM: "The long game, little hoarders. A GRANARY. Stockpile 20,000 kcal, 500 wood and 2,000 kcal of PRESERVED food — food that WAITS. Smoke it, dry it, render it. The audience finds delayed gratification EXOTIC. So do stomachs, we are told."

d18: You say a few words for Klaus. Not a ceremony — just: you were here, and someone noticed you leaving. (-3 trauma)
d18: You bury Klaus. A marker, of sorts. The village will know where. (+4 trauma)
echoSample: d22: "You want to know about that? Okay." "Last time things were different. They always are." "Since Klaus died... I keep expecting to see Klaus at the fire. Stupid."
d22: "I'm picking up Klaus's share of the work. Someone should, and it might as well be me."
